records.cohort_raw: Top 25% of Stores (6 out of 25 Stores)
records.raw_text: The top 25% of Stores (6 out of 25 Stores) had an average unit volume of $860,441. The top 25% of Stores (6 out of 25 Stores) had a median unit volume of $803,139. The top 25% of Stores (6 out of 25 Stores) had the highest unit volume of $1,228,414. The top 25% of Stores (6 out of 25 Stores) had the lowest unit volume of $717,060.
records.notes: Top 25% cohort includes 5 Traditional Stores and 1 Non-Traditional Store (located on a college campus). pct_above_avg from Note 3: 2 of 6 (33.3%) met or exceeded the average of $860,441. Value_min reflects 'lowest unit volume' and value_max reflects 'highest unit volume' within the top 25% cohort.

records.cohort_raw: Bottom 25% of Stores (7 out of 25 Stores)
records.raw_text: The bottom 25% of Stores (7 out of 25 Stores) had an average unit volume of $121,637. The bottom 25% of Stores (7 out of 25 Stores) had a median unit volume of $99,349. The bottom 25% of Stores (7 out of 25 Stores) had the highest unit volume of $210,154. The bottom 25% of Stores (7 out of 25 Stores) had the lowest unit volume of $33,998.
records.notes: Bottom 25% cohort includes 3 Non-Traditional Stores (1 in a casino, 1 in a retail supercenter, 1 in a grocery store); all located inside a c-store with only 1-2 machines and a topping bar. pct_above_avg from Note 3: 3 of 7 (42.9%) met or exceeded the average of $121,637. Value_min reflects 'lowest unit volume' and value_max reflects 'highest unit volume' within the bottom 25% cohort. Data is sales only; excludes costs and expenses per Note 5. Compiled from unaudited franchisee-reported information per Note 6.

notes: Item 19 discloses annual unit volume (gross sales) for the top 25% and bottom 25% performance cohorts among 25 qualifying stores (out of 26 total as of December 28, 2025). One store was excluded for not consistently reporting sales during 2025. The middle 50% cohort (stores ranked 7th–18th) is not separately reported. Data reflects sales only and excludes costs/expenses. FDD filing year is 2026; reporting period covers fiscal year ending December 28, 2025.
